name: OpenWrt Gateway
description: Read-only router health, traffic deltas, CPU/memory, real ping and eight clients per page. Wi-Fi associated, reachable, seen and DHCP-only differ. Cached neighbors and leases are not proof of connectivity; LAN neighbors do not claim physically wired transport.
template:
<Stack data-gp="openwrt" p={6} gap={6} style={{fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box"}}>
{status.snapshot?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red" title="OpenWrt unavailable">Could not refresh router data. Previously observed devices are not being marked offline.</Alert> : !data.snapshot ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Loading OpenWrt…</Text> : <Grid gutter={12}>
<Grid.Col span={{base:12,md:4}}><Stack gap={6}>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={4}><Group gap={6}><TablerIcon name="server" size={18} /><Text size="sm" fw={700}>OpenWrt Gateway</Text></Group><Group gap={4}><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color={data.snapshot?.gateway?.wanUp === true ? "teal" : "red"}>{data.snapshot?.gateway?.wanUp === true ? "WAN up" : data.snapshot?.gateway?.wanUp === false ? "WAN down" : "Unknown"}</Badge><RefreshButton requestId="snapshot" size="xs"/></Group></Group>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={4}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.hostname + " · " + data.snapshot?.gateway?.model}</Text><Anchor href="https://app.example.net" target="_blank" size="xs">LuCI ↗</Anchor></Group>
<SimpleGrid cols={3} spacing={6}><Paper withBorder radius="md" p={6}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Live download</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.3} fw={700} c="teal">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.downloadBps == null ? "Sampling…" : (data.snapshot.gateway.downloadBps * 8 / 1000000).toFixed(2) + " Mbps"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder radius="md" p={6}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Live upload</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.3} fw={700} c="cyan">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.uploadBps == null ? "Sampling…" : (data.snapshot.gateway.uploadBps * 8 / 1000000).toFixed(2) + " Mbps"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder radius="md" p={6}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Internet ping</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.3} fw={700} c="cyan">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.pingMs == null ? "—" : data.snapshot.gateway.pingMs.toFixed(1) + " ms"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder radius="md" p={6}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Router uptime</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.3} fw={700} c="teal">{Math.floor((data.snapshot?.gateway?.uptimeSeconds ?? 0) / 86400) + "d " + Math.floor((data.snapshot?.gateway?.uptimeSeconds ?? 0) % 86400 / 3600) + "h"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder radius="md" p={6}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Packet loss</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.3} fw={700} c="cyan">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.packetLossPercent == null ? "—" : data.snapshot.gateway.packetLossPercent + "%"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder radius="md" p={6}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">WAN IPv4</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.3} fw={700} c="blue">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.wanIp || "—"}</Text></Paper></SimpleGrid>
<Group gap={4}><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="teal">{data.snapshot?.gateway?.cpuPercent == null ? "CPU sampling" : "CPU " + data.snapshot.gateway.cpuPercent + "%"}</Badge><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="cyan">{"RAM " + (data.snapshot?.gateway?.memoryPercent ?? "—") + "%"}</Badge><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="blue">{"OpenWrt " + data.snapshot?.gateway?.version}</Badge></Group>
<Group gap={4}>{(data.snapshot?.radios ?? []).map((r,i) => <Badge key={i} size="xs" variant="outline" color="teal">{(r.band ?? "Radio") + " · ch " + (r.channel ?? "—") + " · " + (r.associated ?? "?") + " clients"}</Badge>)}</Group>
<Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Rates from WAN counters · ping to 1.1.1.1</Text>
</Stack></Grid.Col>
<Grid.Col span={{base:12,md:8}}><Stack gap={5}>
{data.snapshot?.gateway?.neighborsAvailable === false || data.snapshot?.gateway?.leasesAvailable === false || data.snapshot?.gateway?.wifiAssociated == null ? <Alert color="yellow" title="Partial router data"><Text size="xs" lh={1.2}>{data.snapshot?.gateway?.neighborsAvailable === false ? "LAN observations unavailable. " : ""}{data.snapshot?.gateway?.leasesAvailable === false ? "DHCP lease data unavailable. " : ""}{data.snapshot?.gateway?.wifiAssociated == null ? "Wi-Fi association data unavailable." : ""}</Text></Alert> : null}
<Group justify="space-between" gap={4}><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Clients</Text></Group>
<Accordion variant="default" keepMounted defaultValue={null}><Accordion.Item value="filter" style={{border:0}}><Accordion.Control p={0} styles={{label:{padding:"calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0",fontSize:"calc(13px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))",fontFamily:"inherit"}}}>Filter clients{inputs.search ? " · active" : ""}</Accordion.Control><Accordion.Panel styles={{content:{padding:"calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0"}}}><TextInput bind="search" defaultValue="" aria-label="Filter OpenWrt clients" placeholder="Name, IP or MAC…" size="xs"/></Accordion.Panel></Accordion.Item></Accordion>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={6}><SegmentedControl bind="kind" defaultValue="all" size="xs" data={[{label:"All",value:"all"},{label:"Wi-Fi",value:"wireless"},{label:"Other LAN",value:"wired"}]}/><Checkbox bind="leases" defaultValue={false} size="xs" label="DHCP-only" disabled={data.snapshot?.gateway?.leasesAvailable === false}/></Group>
<SimpleGrid cols={{base:2,sm:4}} spacing={6}>{(data.snapshot?.clients ?? []).filter(c => (inputs.leases === true || c.state !== "lease") && ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "all" || ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "wireless" ? c.wireless : !c.wireless)) && (c.name + " " + c.ip + " " + c.mac).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).slice((Number(inputs.page ?? 1)-1)*8,Number(inputs.page ?? 1)*8).map(c => <Paper key={c.mac} data-openwrt-client={c.mac} withBorder radius="md" p={6} style={{minWidth:0,background:"var(--gp-panel,#111c2b)",borderColor:"var(--gp-line,#243247)"}}><Group justify="space-between" gap={3} wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} fw={600} truncate title={c.mac}>{c.name}</Text><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color={c.connected === true ? "teal" : c.state === "lease" ? "yellow" : "gray"}>{c.state === "associated" ? "Wi-Fi" : c.state === "reachable" ? "Live" : c.state === "lease" ? "Lease" : "Seen"}</Badge></Group><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed" truncate title={c.wireless ? c.ssid + " · " + c.band + " · " + c.mac : c.state === "lease" ? "DHCP lease; not confirmed connected" : "LAN neighbor · " + c.interface}>{(c.ip || c.mac) + (c.wireless && c.signal != null ? " · " + c.signal + " dBm" : "")}</Text></Paper>)}</SimpleGrid>{(data.snapshot?.clients ?? []).filter(c => (inputs.leases === true || c.state !== "lease") && ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "all" || ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "wireless" ? c.wireless : !c.wireless)) && (c.name + " " + c.ip + " " + c.mac).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).length === 0 ? <Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">No matching client observations.</Text> : null}<Group justify="space-between" gap={4}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">{(data.snapshot?.clients ?? []).filter(c => (inputs.leases === true || c.state !== "lease") && ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "all" || ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "wireless" ? c.wireless : !c.wireless)) && (c.name + " " + c.ip + " " + c.mac).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).length} devices</Text><Pagination bind="page" defaultValue={1} resetKey={(inputs.search ?? "") + "|" + (inputs.kind ?? "all") + "|" + (inputs.leases === true ? "leases" : "observed")} total={Math.max(1,Math.ceil((data.snapshot?.clients ?? []).filter(c => (inputs.leases === true || c.state !== "lease") && ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "all" || ((inputs.kind ?? "all") === "wireless" ? c.wireless : !c.wireless)) && (c.name + " " + c.ip + " " + c.mac).toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).length/8))} size="xs" siblings={0}/></Group>

</Stack></Grid.Col></Grid>}
</Stack>
